findings.summary: W5 (only filter by origin) has no discriminative test. The W5 case stubs readDocs to return [] for "test-origin" and the other-origin report only for other origins, so runGenerate never receives a foreign-origin report; the case is force-identical to W4's empty case. Origin filtering lives solely in assembleGenerateDeps.readDocs (src/tick-run.ts:1447); deleting that .filter would leave the named W5 test passing (only the W6 production filtering case would fail). Spec §2 W5 requires preloading an origin:"other" report and asserting the full path still runs.

W8 reachability declaration for W5 is inaccurate on both the named test and the mechanism: it claims "若 runGenerate 在 readDocs 返回的 doc 中不按 origin 过滤 ... spawnRole 调用 0 次", but runGenerate performs no origin filtering at all (src/generate.ts:416-430 filters only on doc_kind), and the named case "other origin's report does not prevent normal spawns" would not fail under removal of the origin filter. Spec §2 W8 requires each W1-W5 row to name the uniquely failing case and hold for the production path.

Reuse branch still computes anchorRate/anchorTail that are then discarded: the anchor-rate derivation (total===0 / sums_ok / current_verified_hit/total) and the anchor-json-write-failed tail append run unconditionally, but renderReportHead is only reached under `if (!isReuse)`, so in the reuse path both values are dead. This is the explicit spec §1 prohibition "复用分支里不要重复计算随后被丢弃的量 ... 要么用上，要么不算" (the v1 attempt-1 minor), while the required spawnAnchorCheck call and anchor-check.json write are separate and must stay.

W9 evidence is missing: the dev-note code block for `git status --porcelain | wc -l` contains only the command with no output line, replaced by the parenthetical "（clean worktree 下输出 0）". Spec §2 W9 requires pasting the command's output (`0`) precisely because wc -l always emits a number, so an empty block is indistinguishable from an omission.

Verified as correct and independent of the above: W1 reuse skips all four spawns and all publishes and exports the preloaded report body verbatim with its message_id (src/generate.ts:416-430, 512-525); W2 anchor-check plus anchor-check.json still run in the reuse branch and a checker crash does not block export; W3 raises a loud error naming the origin and the argument count with zero spawn/publish; W4 preserves today's behavior for both empty readDocs and unwired readDocs; production assembleGenerateDeps wires readDocs through readChannelMessages with kind and origin filtering; doc_kind derivation from role, the dr-doc:${role}:${origin} idempotency key, and the anchor-check soft gate are all unchanged, and no 409 is swallowed.
